name: Zero-Masked Residual VQ
aliases: Two-Stage VQ with KNN Grouping and Zero-Masking
definition: A technique that maps small-magnitude residual sub-vectors to a zero index on a group-wise basis to increase index-map sparsity and improve HEVC coding efficiency.
summary: Zero-Masked Residual VQ is a compression technique that maps small-magnitude residual sub-vectors to a zero index to increase sparsity and improve HEVC coding efficiency.
